Dispatched as its own focused spec layer naya5/uncertainty-propagation on naya5/fairness-verification — propagation semantics is distinct from trace composition; extending the existing claim envelope per his direction, not a new engine.
intelligence.essence: Uncertainty propagates through necessary evidence dependencies. Truth qualification follows independently sufficient support. Neither association nor repetition creates proof. A downstream claim can never become more certain, broader, or more causally specific than its admissible evidence supports — but uncertainty in one upstream source must not invalidate a genuinely independent, sufficient alternative. Uncertainty about the cause must not erase evidence of the outcome; certainty about the outcome must not manufacture certainty about its cause. The most intelligent system is not the one that always produces a definitive explanation — it is the one that can reliably say what it knows, what remains possible, what it can safely use, and what test would resolve the rest.
intelligence.falsifier: A hypothesis promoted to fact through a Smart Note summary; an unresolved scheduler-cause hypothesis erasing the independently proven workflow failure; a MENTIONS citation transmitting uncertainty to an unrelated claim; a strengthened claim after mere copying/summarizing/repetition; a staging-only result generalized to production; a cold successor inheriting a simplified claim without its scope and unresolved hypotheses.

human_view.meaning: Think of it as a rule for gossip: a story can never become more certain as it travels. If the original evidence was shaky, every retelling stays shaky — unless there's a genuinely independent second source, which stands on its own. Knowing that a delivery failed doesn't tell you why it failed, and not knowing why doesn't erase the fact that it failed. Every summary, every note, every handoff must carry the uncertainty with it — you can use fewer words, but you can't quietly upgrade 'maybe the scheduler did it' into 'the scheduler did it.' And different uses get different strictness: fine for debugging hypotheses, never for certifying truth.

intelligence.learning_lesson: This formalizes the propagation half of the honesty discipline: SN-0780/SN-0781 establish what happened and what remains uncertain; this governs how that uncertainty FLOWS through every derivation, summary, and projection without amplifying or evaporating. The false-certainty cascade test is the permanent guard — the five-stage fixture (observation → disputed claim → hypothesis → note → successor) that must preserve both the supported narrower finding and the unresolved broader question at every stage.

machine_view.spec_only: Framework ratified; spec branch naya5/uncertainty-propagation to be built and tested. Not wired into live paths until the integration phases reach it.

intelligence.measurement_contract: Ten adversarial acceptance tests: missing log as proof-of-absence → reject; material record disagreement → preserve conflict; proven outcome + unknown cause → preserve both; upstream premise invalidated → recompute dependents; independent alternative valid → preserve it; shared-source double-count → reject; hypothesis copied as fact → reject promotion; staging-only → refuse production generalization; one of two blockers repaired → preserve remainder; cold successor simplified claim → require reconstruction. Plus the false-certainty cascade: corrupt the summary by removing 'unresolved' → VERIFY must reject the strengthened claim; add valid causal evidence → only affected claims recompute.

naya_view.directive: Keep the four uncertainty kinds distinct (partial observability, conflicting evidence, unresolved hypothesis, insufficient evidence). Retain every claim's proof dependencies with their support types. Apply per-relationship propagation semantics — MENTIONS never transmits uncertainty. Propagate observation limits only to inferences depending on the missing events. Preserve causal modality (possible/probable/conditional/observed/verified) through every derivation. Recompute dependency closures monotonically in justification when evidence changes. Preserve uncertainty across all projections. Gate conclusions by intended use.

simple_view.meaning: A story can't get more certain as it's retold. Keep what you know, keep what you don't, and never let a maybe become a fact by repetition.

intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor inherits the propagation semantics, so it can never inherit a simplified claim without reconstructing its actual scope, evidence, and unresolved hypotheses.
intelligence.uncertainty: Framework ratified; spec not yet built. Join point with the causal-trace uncertainty representation is the claim envelope.
